end.summary:
Practised the difference between an organ and an organ system using human examples.
Practised ordering cell, tissue, organ, organ system, and organism.
Practised examples of levels of organisation in humans and plants.
Yash ordered the levels correctly in the final explanation but did not pass the teach-back.
end.parentNote: Asha practised how one organ differs from an organ system, including the roles of the heart, blood vessels, stomach, liver, and intestine. Yash used the sequence cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism and explained that cells group to form tissues and tissues form organs. There was some mix-up about whether the intestine is part of the stomach and whether the heart itself is the circulatory system; these were corrected during the lesson. At home, ask Yash to make one human and one plant example for each level and explain the sequence aloud.
